ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged decorative streetlight fixture
DETAILS: The photo shows a decorative twin-arm streetlight against a bright sky. The left lamp fixture is missing its bulb and housing, leaving only the internal components exposed. The right fixture has a bulb but appears to be missing a globe or cover.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Street Lighting
WHY: The location is on West 86th Street within the City of New York. The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) maintains approximately 400,000 streetlights on city roadways and pathways, including decorative lampposts approved for use on city streets.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City, and is a national leader in using sustainable street lighting."
